content.rationale: Marker state is four variables with empty/unset/zero/zero init. U reifies the undone count and B the redo bound — the pair count when the undone count was last set from nothing-undone, which is what makes D15b's no-newer window checkable from the state alone; positions are restore targets. Composition of the leg actions and the invariants over them live with the check assembly that runs them.
